title: How many cultural sites in Ukraine will be damaged as of December 31, 2026, according to UNESCO?
resolution_criteria: This question resolves as the total number of cultural sites in Ukraine that have been confirmed as damaged as of December 31, 2026, according to the [UNESCO tracker](https://www.unesco.org/en/ukraine-war/damaged-cultural-sites?hub=180699).
fine_print: If the [UNESCO tracker](https://www.unesco.org/en/ukraine-war/damaged-cultural-sites?hub=180699) is not specifically updated on December 31, 2026, this question will resolve as the number as of the latest updated date in 2026.
background:
Since February 2022, when[ <u>Russia invaded Ukraine</u>](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russo-Ukrainian_war_\(2022%E2%80%93present\)) in a major escalation of[ <u>the existing war from 2014</u>](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russo-Ukrainian_war), UNESCO has been implementing emergency and medium-term measures in Ukraine. "Recognizing the crucial role of culture, education, and information in times of war,[ <u>UNESCO has mobilized more than US \$75 million</u>](https://www.unesco.org/en/ukraine-war?hub=180699), with the support of its Member States and other partners," to support emerging needs including protecting cultural sites.

In[ <u>Rebuilding the foundations of peace</u>](https://unesdoc.unesco.org/ark:/48223/pf0000384454), UNESCO reported how the organization has supported the revival of Ukraine's cultural sector; protected heritage and art works; safeguarded living heritage; supported the continuity of education and children's wellbeing; promoted freedom of expression and bolstered the Ukrainian media sector; and addressed the deepening impact on the environment and science.

> By the beginning of January 2025, UNESCO had confirmed damage to more than 470 cultural sites in Ukraine including: museums, monuments, libraries, religious sites, archives, buildings of historical, religious, archaeological or artistic interest.

As of 23 September 2026, [560 cultural sites have been confirmed as damaged](https://www.unesco.org/en/ukraine-war/damaged-cultural-sites?hub=180699) (164 religious sites, 283 buildings of historical and/or artistic interest, 43 museums, 33 monuments, 24 libraries, 8 archaeological sites, 5 archives). This was 15 more (8 religious sites, 2 buildings of historical and/or artistic interest, 2 libraries and 3 archaeological sites) than the last update on 29 July.
